name: Scrob
description: Scrob is a self-hosted media tracker in the spirit of Letterboxd and Trakt. It syncs libraries from Jellyfin, Plex, Emby, Nuvio and Stremio, records watch history, ratings and lists, and supports real-time scrobbling via webhooks as well as Trakt, Simkl and MDBList integration through a progressive web app.

notes.text: Open http://<IP>:7330 and create the first account - the first user can always register, even though further registrations are disabled by default. Set ENABLE_REGISTRATIONS=true in /opt/scrob/.env and run 'systemctl restart scrob-backend' to allow more users.
A TMDB Read Access Token is required for metadata. Add it under Settings -> General after the first login, then connect your media servers under Connections -> Media Players.
Configuration lives in /opt/scrob/.env and uploads/image caches in /opt/scrob_data, so both survive updates. Watch history is stored in the local PostgreSQL database.
